definitions.explanation: The manager in charge of a section (課) within a department in a company.

examples.japanese: {課長|かちょう}に{相談|そうだん}してください。
examples.english: Please consult with the section chief.

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}{課長|かちょう}は{来週|らいしゅう}{出張|しゅっちょう}です。
examples.english: Section Chief Tanaka has a business trip next week.

examples.japanese: やっと{課長|かちょう}に{昇進|しょうしん}しました。
examples.english: I finally got promoted to section chief.

notes: 課長 manages a 課 (section), which is a subdivision of a 部 (department). It's an important first management position in Japanese companies. The typical hierarchy is 係長 → 課長 → 部長. Used as a title (田中課長).
